item.title: Powerful earthquake shakes Kabul, Afghanistan
item.description: ALBAWABA - A relatively strong earthquake struck the Afghan capital of Kabul a few moments ago, local media revealed on Wednesday.There is no information yet about possible damage caused by the quake. However, the quake was also felt in neighboring Pakistan.A relatively strong earthquake shook Kabul a few moments ago.There is no information yet about possible damages caused by the quake. item.title: Video: Mud volcano erupts in Colombia
